articles.summary: Net Income of $61.2 million , EPS of $0.73 Operating Earnings of $64.7 million , Operating EPS of $0.77 Quarterly Dividend of $0.3225 Board Increases Stock Buyback Authorization to $125 million BOSTON, Oct. 21, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Beacon Financial Corporation (NYSE: BBT) (the “Company”) today announced net income of $61.2 million, or $0.73 per basic and diluted share, for the third quarter of 2026, compared to $64.4 million, or $0.77 per basic and diluted share, for the second quarter of 2026, and a net loss of $(4.2) million, or $(0.05) per basic share, for the third quarter of 2025. The Company reported operating earnings after tax (non-GAAP) of $64.7 million, or $0.77 per basic and diluted share, for the third quarter of 2026, compared to operating earnings after tax (non-GAAP) of $64.4 million, or $0.77 per basic and diluted share, for the second quarter of 2026, and $34.0 million, or $0.39 per basic and diluted share, for the third quarter of 2025. “Our quarterly results
articles.title: Beacon Financial Corporation Announces Third Quarter Results
